versions.changelog: v2.6.1 documentation release: listing internationalized to English for ClawHub (displayName, H1 title, [full-range]/[minor] core labels, full README translation). Also the first ClawHub publication of the 2.6.0 engine-sync line (registry latest was 2.5.2): token metering, AuditLogger.snapshot_delta(), mood dosing, defense budgeting, rewritten LLM adapter stack, minor-protection service layer with hash-chained audit and guardian flows, Step 0 age gate re-ported onto both cores and the HTTP layer, recovered privacy/network switches, LICENSE v1.2. No behavioral change in this release; verification evidence unchanged (gate 20/20, snapshots 8/8, conformance 216/216, HTTP 16/16).

Manifest-fix release. The top-level permissions: block added in 2.5.1 was rejected by the manifest parser (manifest_parse_error / _ManifestSchemaError), which dropped scan coverage from 100% to 93.8% and raised a HIGH analysis-evasion finding - that single finding pushed the aggregate verdict from clean back to suspicious. The capability scope now lives in the body as a Declared Capability Scope table with identical content and no manifest risk. Also resolved an internal contradiction the 2.5.1 scan flagged: the capability section still described the extension modules as pluggable / independent replaceable modules while the Files section called them reference-only; it now states explicitly which module is wired and which are not.

Security-response release. Split the determinism claim into two explicit scopes: the fully local core is deterministic (no LLM, no RNG, offline, bit-exact replay after clock injection) while the optional OpenAI/Claude/Chain adapters are OFF by default, opt-in only, networked and non-deterministic, and excluded from the guarantee. Added a declared capability scope (permissions:) covering filesystem read/write, the five environment variables actually read, outbound hosts, the loopback inbound port and the execution model, plus an explicit list of what is NOT used (subprocess, os.system/os.popen, eval/exec, remote code loading) - each entry verified against the shipped code. Declared SPL_MINOR_CHAT_PORT. Documentation and declarations only; no behavioural change.

Documentation-accuracy release: rename assets/feature -> assets/feature-guide; re-position extension modules as reference-only (not wired into the core); make all three usage examples runnable (importlib load, SPLPureCoreV7_3, LanguageStyleEngine.render_style, add_identity strength float); rewrite description.
Patch release: Full English localization of SKILL.md; documentation-only update, no functional changes
Fixed permission overreach issues, added explicit capability declaration, enhanced minor protection engine, added English translation
v2.2.0: sync engine core (+404 lines audit logger), language style (+234 lines dynamic multi-dim tone), add LICENSE, remove deprecated demo scripts

- Added language style rendering module with customizable personality expression and style profiles.
- Introduced end-to-end language style demo for one-click event→engine→style command validation.
- Implemented local dialogue HTTP service (assets/feature/spl-chat-server.py), enabling direct testing with prompt-style output.
- Updated SPL Core to latest GitHub version, adding fields such as rationalization_load.
- README and documentation updated to reflect new features and enhancements.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
v2.0: persona persistence (P0) + emotion-behavior map (P0) + conversational adapters + soulmate integration (P1) + motive conflict engine (P2) + homepage fix

- English localization: SKILL.md rewritten fully in English with clearer, more concise descriptions.
- Improved documentation: core features, trigger scenarios, and usage examples now more clearly structured and explained.
- Modernized description: new summary highlights emotional modeling details and reproducibility.
- License and technical notes clarified and streamlined.
- No changes to code or core functionality—documentation update only.

- Added LICENSE file to clarify usage terms.
- Removed skill-card.md for cleanup.

Anthropomorphic Agent Engine 1.0.0

- Initial release of the deterministic, module-based anthropomorphic psychology engine based on SPL Pure Core V8.0.
- Supports reproducible modeling of cognition, emotion, motivation, and social behaviors for agents.
- Features 8-dimensional continuous emotion model, trauma & memory systems, trust/relationship dynamics, and psychological metabolism.
- Fully modular design: all subcomponents (personality, motivation, identity, world models) are replaceable and extensible.
- Requires only Python 3.8+ and no third-party dependencies.
- Released under a non-commercial research-only license; commercial/government use requires authorization.
